purpose: Search and choose multiple option IDs with removable chips and grouped results.
behaviorProvider: Base UI Combobox multiple mode with shared Tag and Spinner.

component: Keep an array of selected stable strings from value or defaultValue. Deduplicate requested updates and show up to the bounded maxVisible chips with an accessible overflow summary.

Filter local options by label, description and keywords unless filterOptions=false. Support a separate controlled search string. Closing the popup requests an empty query; the host supplies remote results and loading state.

Render option groups and descriptions. Select all adds enabled filtered options; Clear requests an empty array. loading disables result and Select all actions but is not a read-only lock on existing selection.

Delegate list navigation to Base UI. Empty-query Backspace removes the last selected ID unless the key event is composing. Removing a visible chip schedules focus to a nearby remaining remove action or the trigger when focus has not moved elsewhere.

Resolve Field state on the trigger and pass name to Base UI multiple Root for form participation. Disabled state suppresses popup opening. This wrapper exposes value/open/search callbacks as values without primitive detail objects.
host: Supply stable unique option values, controlled state acceptance and accessible labels. Own remote request cancellation/races, selected-label retention, validation and persistence; the component does not request data.

Owned styling belongs to the input token group. Actual nested shared components retain their own group and behavior; preserve four theme/mode mappings and keyboard-visible focus.

limitations: Source-backed requirements, not a current test certification or release approval.
No readOnly, external form, free-solo option creation, list virtualization or primitive callback-detail API is exposed.
A loading list does not freeze chip removal or Clear; loading is request presentation, not an authorization boundary.
Unavailable selected IDs display their raw IDs when not present in options.
